correctness.rationale: For every fixed label subset and specified rooted fringe topology, contraction gives probability t_(n-k+1)/t_n; for disjoint prescribed patterns double contraction gives t_(n-k-l+2)/t_n. Descendant sets are laminar, and each balanced-four fringe has exactly two cherries whereas each asymmetric four fringe has one. First moments and disjoint products yield the two exact rational covariances. Direct checks at n=4,5 settle boundary terms; the sign polynomials are positive for n>=5. A separate finite enumerator checked 146650 integer/rational assertions for all labeled rooted trees through eight leaves; it is not used as the infinite proof.

evidence: Choi, Kaur, Thompson and Wu (2024) compute full four-subtree covariance matrices for uniform **unrooted** phylogenetic trees; their full text and theorem statements were inspected.
Chang and Fuchs (2009) give a broadly applicable rooted single-pattern enumerative framework.
broader_coverage.reasoning: The 2024 unrooted quantities count edge-split motifs without an ancestral-root direction; they do not determine rooted descendant-four-leaf balance. Even a fixed unlabeled five-leaf unrooted tree can arise from adding an outgroup to rooted balanced or asymmetric four-leaf trees, yielding different rooted B counts. This rules out direct identity of the statistics, not every possible indirect derivation. Older generic fringe enumerations may subsume much of the counting method without explicitly asserting the mixed-moment sign theorem.

originality.rationale: The inspected older full texts on rooted single-pattern counts (Chang–Fuchs) and joint cherry/pitchfork counts (Wu–Choi) do not explicitly imply the exact two rooted four-leaf shape mixed covariances. The 2018 quartet index is induced rather than fringe, and the closest 2024 exact four-pattern covariance work is unrooted, which loses root direction and does not determine rooted fringe counts. Three semantic searches of the claim, shapes and equivalents yielded no exact matches; nearby results on other rooted random-tree dependence do not imply the formula. Priority remains qualified because general fringe-pattern counting methods may contain an implicit specialization and full literature search is never exhaustive.
residual_risks: Generic rooted fringe-pattern moment formulas may already imply these mixed statistics; an older explicit specialization may exist.
The 2024 unrooted full covariance analysis is extremely close in method, despite different random variables and sample space.
Search and manuscript inspections cannot establish literature-wide uniqueness or independent priority.

value.rationale: Four-leaf rooted binary subtrees are the first shape-distinguishing local motifs. Theorem proves that their two natural shape classes have opposite covariance with the common cherry count for every tree size, with nonvanishing order-n magnitude and a monotone finite-size ratio. This gives directly usable dependence information for jointly calibrating rooted phylogenetic tree balance statistics and is not an arbitrary parameter slice.
